evidence.locator: Abstract: “a CNN trained to distinguish clear cell, chromophobe and papillary RCC achieves a classification accuracy of 94.07%”
evidence.note: The authors’ reported figure. The abstract does not say how it was aggregated; the best patch-wise figure in Table 3 is 92.62% (ResNet-18 + DAG-SVM). The subtype task spans all three renal projects, so this figure belongs to the three cohorts jointly and is not a result for papillary cases alone.
